description: This source file defines an Android activity named MultiPropertyAnimation that demonstrates various property animations on graphical objects (balls). It includes inner classes for custom views and animation logic, showcasing multi-property animations using ObjectAnimator and AnimatorSet.

classes.name: MultiPropertyAnimation
classes.description: Android Activity that sets up and handles the animation demo, including button clicks to trigger animations.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom View that manages animated graphical objects (balls) and constructs property animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content layout, adds the custom view, and sets up button click listener.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Constructs complex property animations for each ball object.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates and adds a new ball shape to the animation view at specified coordinates.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Called on each animation frame to invalidate (redraw) the view.
